ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago (the “Chicago Zoning Ordinance”) is
amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols
and indications as shown on Map No. 7-K of the District Map, in the area bounded by:

a line 326.08 feet north of and parallel to West Fullerton Avenue;

North Lowell Avenue; a line 301.08 feet north of and parallel to West Fullerton Avenue;
the public alley next west of and parallel to North Lowell Avenue,

to those of an RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
publication.

Common Address: 2426 North Lowell Avenue, Chicago, Illinois 60639
